hooks.command: LOCK="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/.install.lock"; REQ="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/requirements.txt"; CACHED="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/requirements.txt"; if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then exit 0; fi; diff -q "$REQ" "$CACHED" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; touch "$LOCK" && python3 -m venv "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv" && "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv/bin/pip" install -q -r "$REQ" && cp "$REQ" "$CACHED" && rm -f "$LOCK" || rm -f "$LOCK"
